response.overview: Salma, who refuses to be forced into an arranged marriage by her father, runs away to Bandungan. There, she meets Farhad, a mysterious motorcyclist who saves her from danger. A series of unexpected events—including a tense night at a haunted motel—gradually brings the two of them closer together. Farhad then takes Salma to Ratna’s house, where she works. Salma’s presence, however, provokes Yoga, Ratna’s husband, to sexually assault her. Farhad manages to save her, though. Still traumatized, Salma is cared for and protected by Farhad until love begins to blossom between them. When Farhad has to leave because his mother is ill, Salma is forced to return to the arranged marriage she has long refused.
response.title: Takdir yang Nakal
